description: This Java class manages the connection status within a system, tracking whether the system is connected, loading, or not connected. It listens to engine time, sensor updates, and message events to update its connection state accordingly.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus
classes.description: Manages and monitors the connection status, updating based on engine time, sensor data, and message content.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus.Value
classes.description: Enumeration representing connection states: NOT_CONNECTED, LOADING, CONNECTED.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus.Listener
classes.description: Interface for objects that want to listen to connection status changes.

methods.name: executeOnceConnected
methods.description: Executes a Runnable once the connection is established.

methods.name: markConnected
methods.description: Updates the connection status to indicate a connection has been established.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the connection status value and notifies listeners if changed.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns true if the system is connected.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current connection status value.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to be notified of connection status changes.
